prompt:
Build a complete complex-baseband terrestrial digital-video packet link in Simulink using the DVB-T 2k-mode signal structure. A source of 188-byte packets must pass through shortened Reed-Solomon (204,188) outer coding, outer convolutional interleaving, rate-3/4 punctured convolutional coding, DVB-T bit and symbol interleaving, nonhierarchical normalized 64-QAM mapping, 2048-point OFDM modulation, and an AWGN channel. The receiver must perform OFDM demodulation, soft 64-QAM demapping, matching inner deinterleaving and Viterbi decoding, outer deinterleaving, Reed-Solomon decoding, and packet recovery. Read ChannelSNR_dB, SourceSeed, and NoiseSeed from the MATLAB base workspace; their nominal values are 18.5 dB, 1234573, and 54321, and their supported ranges are 17 to 22 dB and integer seeds from 1 to 10000000. Assume a clean MATLAB session in which only the declared public inputs are provided; every other parameter, table, and initialization dependency must be self-contained. Across the declared SNR and seed range, the full receiver must recover source packets and must expose both the post-inner-decoder and final post-outer-decoder error measurements. Log MATLAB Timeseries named SourcePackets, RSCodedBytes, InnerCodedBits, TxQAMSymbols, TxOFDMWaveform, RxOFDMWaveform, SoftMetrics, InnerDecodedBits, RecoveredPackets, InnerBERStats, and OuterBERStats. The required widths in that same order are 188, 204, 1632, 1512, 2048, 2048, 1512, 1632, 188, 3, and 3. SourcePackets and RecoveredPackets contain 188 packet-byte channels; RSCodedBytes contains 204 coded-byte channels; InnerCodedBits and InnerDecodedBits contain 1632 bit channels; TxQAMSymbols contains 1512 normalized complex 64-QAM-symbol channels; TxOFDMWaveform and RxOFDMWaveform each contain 2048 complex OFDM-sample channels; and SoftMetrics contains 1512 real soft-metric channels. Each signal must come from its actual connected processing stage and retain that stage's public data type: packet bytes, coded bits or bytes, complex QAM or OFDM samples, soft metrics, or recovered packet bytes as applicable. InnerBERStats and OuterBERStats each have 3 channels in this order: bit-error rate, cumulative error count, and cumulative compared-bit count. Work directly in the required model file and keep the latest usable state saved at that path throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XCOMM08.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
